payload.release_notes:
Restores usable Nesting roll stock after an empty System catalogue. Keeps saved custom widths, recovers widths from saved Nest profiles when the material cache was erased, and applies valid new System widths exactly. Empty or unavailable stock no longer erases the saved roll definitions. Uses a connected System with usable stock when the preferred System has none. Includes the compact roll preview and precise layout editing.

Jobs sent by System are verified and cached in Documents before Ready To Print. The Download action saves a separate copy in the configured Downloads folder. Trash and Restore sync across printers, and trashed files stay recoverable.
